definitions.gloss: saliva swallowed involuntarily from anticipation, desire, or nervousness
definitions.explanation: Saliva that one swallows instinctively, typically when seeing delicious food, feeling greedy anticipation, or experiencing nervous tension.

examples.japanese: おいしそうなケーキを{見|み}て{生唾|なまつば}を{飲|の}んだ。
examples.english: I gulped at the sight of the delicious-looking cake.

examples.japanese: {緊張|きんちょう}して{生唾|なまつば}を{飲|の}みながら{結果|けっか}{発表|はっぴょう}を{待|ま}った。
examples.english: I waited nervously for the results, swallowing hard with tension.

notes:
USAGE:
{生唾|なまつば} almost always appears in the expression {生唾|なまつば}を{飲|の}む (to swallow saliva), which conveys either eager anticipation or nervous tension. It is not used as a neutral medical or scientific term for saliva — {唾液|だえき} is the clinical term.

FORMS:
{生|なま} (raw, involuntary) + {唾|つば} (saliva).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {生唾|なまつば}を{飲|の}む: to gulp, to swallow hard
- {生唾|なまつば}を{飲|の}み{込|こ}む: to gulp down saliva
- {思|おも}わず{生唾|なまつば}を{飲|の}む: to involuntarily gulp
